ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a “distribution map of temperature and precipitation near the 2°E meridian of a certain country.” The horizontal axis is labeled latitude, from about 42° to 52°; the left vertical axis is temperature/℃, and the right vertical axis is precipitation/mm. The legend shows curves such as January and July precipitation as well as January and July average temperature, reflecting the north-south climate changes of this country near the 2°E meridian. Then reason: The 2°E meridian passes through western Europe, and combined with the latitude range in the figure of about 42°N—52°N, this country can mainly be located as France. In France's electricity supply structure, nuclear power dominates, so this country's electricity is mainly supplied by nuclear power.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the “distribution map of temperature and precipitation near the 2°E meridian of a certain country.”

<image1>

What type of power generation is the electricity of this country mainly supplied by?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中横轴标出42°、44°、46°、48°、50°、52°等纬度，左轴为气温、右轴为降水量，表示某国沿2°E经线附近的气温和降水分布。再根据文字中的“某国2°E经线附近”结合图中纬度范围42°N—52°N进行地图定位，判断该国是法国。最后调用法国能源结构知识，法国电力主要依靠核电供应，因此答案为核电。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一幅“某国2°E经线附近气温、降水量分布图”。横轴标注纬度，从约42°到52°；左侧纵轴是气温/℃，右侧纵轴是降水量/mm。图例显示有1月、7月降水以及1月、7月平均气温等曲线，反映该国沿2°E经线附近南北方向的气候变化。再推理：2°E经线经过欧洲西部，结合图中纬度范围约42°N—52°N，可定位该国主要为法国。法国电力供应结构中核电占主导，因此该国电力主要依靠核电供应。
